title: TimeSkeleton bundle file
description: A TimeSkeleton 0.7.0 bundle file: one alignment bundle with all its timelines and its groups, self-contained. The file holds one timelines array with every root timeline of the bundle, so every timeline occurs exactly once; each group, as defined by the group document, names its members by id in that array, a root or a descendant at any depth. A timeline is a member of at most one group; a child may belong to one group while its root belongs to another or to none. The roots no group names are the bundle's ungrouped timelines. Timeline ids, roots and descendants alike, are unique across the file; group ids are unique among the groups and differ from every timeline id; every other id is unique within its own timeline manifest, as in a timeline file. The timelines and the groups are sorted by id and each group's members by code point, and readers accept any order; the members' display order of each group is presentation and lives in graphical.order. Object keys carry no order and are written sorted by code point.

timelines.description: Every root timeline of the bundle, each a complete timeline manifest with all its descendants, sorted by id.

Bundle.description: An alignment bundle: its identity, its support policy and its groups. Its timelines are the file's timelines array.

name.description: Human-readable name, or null when none was given.

support_policy.description: How the bundle treats a coordinate transferred to another timeline that falls outside the alignment's support: omit drops that timeline from the answer, clamp clamps the coordinate to the nearest supported position, extrapolate extends the alignment linearly; no policy yields a coordinate outside the target timeline's [0, length].

groups.description: The groups of the bundle, sorted by id.

BundleGraphical.description: The presentation of the bundle file: the display order of each group's members, and named styles and statements with exactly the meaning they have in a timeline file's graphical block (`docs/drawing.md`, sections 2 and 8).

order.description: The display order of each group's members, keyed by group id; each value is a permutation of that group's members. A group without an entry is displayed in the order of its members.
